appDesc.message: Remaining Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini usage — 5-hour & weekly limits — in a popup and toolbar badge. Reads only your own usage pages.

reset_date_fmt.description: Reset date shown when it is more than a day away. {mo} month, {day} day, {wd} weekday, {hh}:{mi} 24h time.

checked.description: {age} is a relative time like '3m ago'

note_no_permission.message: No site permission. Turn the service off and on to allow.

badge_pct.description: {pct} is the remaining percent, e.g. '50%'. Shown in the toolbar tooltip.

badge_sep.description: Joins the value and the reset time in the toolbar tooltip.

badge_note_fmt.description: Wraps a short status note at the end of a toolbar tooltip line.

refused_note.message: You must allow the site permission to turn this on.

note_main.message: Numbers are the remaining percent. Gemini is read while its usage page (gemini.google.com/usage) tab is open.

overlay_hint.message: Open it from a normal web page tab.

overlay_empty.message: Turn on a service in the popup.

account_n.description: Name of a Claude organization whose plan is unknown. {n} is its position, e.g. 2.

peers_label_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the profile name field

peers_hint.message: Turn this on in each Chrome profile where Leeway is installed to see their usage here too. Needs the Leeway helper.

peers_none.message: No other profile has shared its usage yet.

peers_helper_missing.message: The Leeway helper isn't installed. Run leeway-helper.exe once, then turn this on again.

peers_helper_failed.message: Couldn't reach the Leeway helper. Run leeway-helper.exe again to repair it.

peers_updated.description: {age} is a relative time like '3m ago'
